title: Scalar-extension and scalar-restriction sheaf adjunction
statement: For a ring k, topological space X, ring sheaf R and alpha:k -> R(X), the scalar extension [def-sc-field-scalar-extension] of ModuleCat-valued sheaves is left adjoint to forgetToSheafModuleCat at the terminal open followed by sheafCompose of ModuleCat.restrictScalars alpha. This holds for modules in Type(max u v) and does not require k to be a field.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: Compose the presheaf pullback/pushforward hom equivalence supplied by [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists] with the Mathlib module sheafification hom equivalence for the identity of R. Interpret homs from [def-sc-module-presheaf-constant-modules] to the presheaf pushforward as natural k-linear maps into the displayed scalar restriction. In each direction preserve the underlying component function and prove the linearity and naturality laws directly. The two conversions are inverse by extensionality.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: Check naturality in the input using the two adjunction naturality identities and Functor.map_comp; check naturality in the output using the right naturality identities and componentwise extensionality. Apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv to these natural bijections. The universe-adjusted sheafification is the one in [def-sc-field-scalar-extension].
